# Tests that pass and print, for the rust_test jobs in
# .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml. A passing test's output can be a skip in
# words the skip scan does not know ("nothing to test"), so the job fails for
# every passing test that prints and is not named here. A test that prints
# the skip marker `skipped: <reason>` (or a word the scan knows) skipped
# itself, named here or not. Add a line only after reading the test: what it
# prints, and why that is no skip. A named test that prints nothing gets a
# notice.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <what it prints; why it is no skip>.
//crates/pi-ast:pi-ast_test block::tests::pruned_walk_matches_unpruned_on_full_repo_corpus  the number of files and comparisons of its sweep, after asserting more than 3000 files (run alone with --ignored, .github/sami/rust-test-ignored.txt)
